hide_when_zero.label: Hide when zero
hide_when_zero.description: Hide the bar widget when there are no hidden windows from the current workspace.

scratch_workspace.label: Scratchpad workspace name
scratch_workspace.description: Name of the Niri workspace used to hide scratchpad windows.

prevent_selecting_scratch.label: Prevent selecting scratch
prevent_selecting_scratch.description: Wrap existing Niri workspace-up/down keybindings so they skip the scratchpad workspace. The panel header provides an Open Scratch button while enabled.

niri_config_path.label: Niri config file
niri_config_path.description: Exact Niri config.kdl path to manage. Leave blank to use NIRI_CONFIG or the default ~/.config/niri/config.kdl.
